issues.description: The problem statement's UML and descriptions specify orderMeal(Meal) as returning void, but the provided solution implements orderMeal(Meal) returning boolean. This mismatch in return type can confuse students about the correct method signature to implement and may cause test or compilation mismatches if the expected signature differs.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent between specification and implementation. Either change the solution's orderMeal signature to 'public void orderMeal(Meal meal)' (and adjust callers/tests if they relied on a boolean) or update the problem statement/UML to indicate orderMeal returns boolean. Preferably change the solution to match the UML/spec (void) so students implement the method as documented.
